prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1068; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Appraiser's remarks: The left rear quarter panel and rear door show crushed metal and a sprung intrusion beam consistent with a side impact at an intersection, and the pattern of contact matches the account provided. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known from the records reviewed. The repair plan calls for panel replacement, door realignment, and refinishing, and the labor hours listed fit the extent of the damage. Two similar charges submitted on the same day are currently under review and have not been approved. Final authorization will follow once that review is complete.
